text:
Olivia (Finance): @here Quick update: We're rolling out an update to billing, quotas, and free credits that goes live May 1. Short version: small rate-limit increases for free-tier, new overage grace window, and changes to how promo credits expire. Details below.

Matt (Eng): Can you TL;DR the overage change?

Olivia (Finance): TL;DR: starting May 1, customers on metered plans get a 72-hour grace window after hitting a quota before overage charges apply. We still send warnings at 80% and 95%.

Jessica (PM): Are quotas per-api-key or per-account?

Olivia (Finance): Per-account for billing purposes; per-api-key counters still shown in Console for debugging.

Sam (Support): How will this appear on invoices? Will we see both usage and grace-window credits?

finance-bot: Sample invoice line: 
```
Usage: 1,250,000 tokens
Overage charged (post-grace): 10,000 tokens @ $0.0009 = $9.00
Grace-window credit: -10,000 tokens = $0.00 (no charge during grace)
```
(We will include a new line item called "Grace window protection" for visibility.)

Nina (Legal): Note: the grace window is a billing convenience and not an entitlement; terms updated in the billing TOS draft (link in doc).

Matt (Eng): Rate-limit increases for free-tier — what are the numbers?

Olivia (Finance): Free-tier rate limits (requests/sec) go from 2 rps -> 4 rps for text endpoints; embedding free-tier goes from 1 rps -> 2 rps. This is to reduce bursts that cause poor UX. Dedicated & paid customers unaffected.

Jessica (PM): Promo credit changes? A few enterprise pilots asked how long credits last.

Olivia (Finance): New policy: promotional credits issued after May 1 expire 180 days from issuance (was 365). Existing issued credits retain original expiry. We'll surface expiry on Console and in email notices.

Sam (Support): Any self-serve options if customers need extension?

Olivia (Finance): For self-serve: customers can apply a promo extension via support form; auto-approval for extensions up to 30 days for qualifying startups. Larger extensions require CS review.

Matt (Eng): Rollout plan?

Olivia (Finance): Rollout: internal doc + API header changes next week, Console UI updates in 2 weeks, emails to affected customers 7 days before May 1. We'll patch the usage webhook schema with a new "grace_window_expires_at" field. Engineering will get the API contract in #eng-platform today.

Jessica (PM): Will there be an all-hands?

Olivia (Finance): Briefing at Friday sync (10:00 PT) + recorded explainer. Link to draft FAQ and billing change doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/grace-window-2026 (please read & comment).

Sam (Support): I'll update the canned responses. Thanks — will escalate any immediate issues here. :thumbsup:

Olivia (Finance): Thanks team. If you spot messaging that could confuse customers, drop edits on the doc or ping me.

finance-bot: Notification scheduled: Customer emails will be sent on 2026-04-24 09:00 UTC.
